name: Zettai Zetsumei Ookami-san!
original_name: 絶体絶命オオカミさん！
source:
Once upon a time, there was a wolf.
He was hungry, so he ventured out to catch his prey like he normally would.
A road with three branches stretched out before him...
Unaware of how these branching paths will control his destiny,
he picked one of them without much thought.
Will he be able to return home unscathed?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/14613]Freem![/url]]
translation:
从前，有一匹狼。
他饿了，于是像往常一样出门捕猎。
一条分成三岔的道路出现在他面前……

他不知道这些岔路会如何左右自己的命运，
便毫不犹豫地选了一条。
他能平安无事地回到家吗？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/14613]Freem![/url]]
